beech.d: any of several large deciduous trees with rounded spreading crowns and smooth grey bark and small sweet edible triangular nuts enclosed in burs; north temperate regions

beethoven.d: German composer of instrumental music (especially symphonic and chamber music); continued to compose after he lost his hearing (1770-1827)

beer.d: a general name for alcoholic beverages made by fermenting a cereal (or mixture of cereals) flavored with hops

beebread.d: a mixture of nectar and pollen prepared by worker bees and fed to larvae

bee.d: any of numerous hairy-bodied insects including social and solitary species

beecher.d: United States clergyman who was a leader for the abolition of slavery (1813-1887)

beekeeper.d: a farmer who keeps bees for their honey

beelzebub.d: chief spirit of evil and adversary of God; tempter of mankind

beekeeping.d: the cultivation of bees on a commercial scale for the production of honey

beet.d: biennial Eurasian plant usually having a swollen edible root; widely cultivated as a food crop

beefcake.d: a photograph of a muscular man in minimal attire

beehive.d: a man-made receptacle that houses a swarm of bees

beeswax.d: a yellow to brown wax secreted by honeybees to build honeycombs

beeper.d: an electronic device that generates a series of beeps when the person carrying it is being paged

beechwood.d: wood of any of various beech trees; used for flooring and containers and plywood and tool handles

beefeater.d: officer in the (ceremonial) bodyguard of the British monarch

beefalo.d: hardy breed of cattle resulting from crossing domestic cattle with the American buffalo; yields leaner beef than conventional breeds

beechnut.d: small sweet triangular nut of any of various beech trees

beechen.d: consisting of or made of wood of the beech tree

beefsteak.d: a beef steak usually cooked by broiling

beef neck.d: a cut of beef from the neck of the animal

beefwood.d: a tropical hardwood tree yielding balata gum and heavy red timber

beer glass.d: a relatively large glass for serving beer

beetle off.d: leave suddenly and as if in a hurry

beer mat.d: a drip mat placed under a glass of beer

beer garden.d: tavern with an outdoor area (usually resembling a garden) where beer and other alcoholic drinks are served

beef tongue.d: the tongue of a cow eaten as meat

beef man.d: a man who raises (or tends) cattle

beef cattle.d: cattle that are reared for their meat

beer maker.d: someone who brews beer or ale from malt and hops and water

beer mug.d: a mug intended for serving beer

beef tea.d: an extract of beef (given to people who are ill)

beer hall.d: a hall or barroom featuring beer and (usually) entertainment
